sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Emergency Vehicles, Golf Carts, and Low-Speed Vehicles

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Oncoming rigs demand the right edge while passing a rig demands the left lane, so direction decides the side [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-sides; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F01, sec11-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Right-turning rigs swing wide left first, which makes the gap between rig and curb a blind trap rather than an opening [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-turns; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
A backing rig hides everything behind its bulk, so crossing behind it is banned whether it is moving or only preparing [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-backing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A01
A legal rig pass chains four moves: check both ways, take the lane only when clear and safe, signal, and blink headlights at its driver [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-passing; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A01
Finish rig passes fast on the left and merge back only after spotting the cab in your mirror, because lingering in the blind spot or cutting in early both risk a crash [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-merge; difficulty high; prereq sec11-R04; confusables sec11-F05, sec11-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A01
Downgrades forbid passing a rig while being passed by one forbids speeding up, and both cases keep you right [A01].
Why it matters: group cmv-grade; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F07, sec11-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A01
Sirens or flashing lights from police, fire, or rescue vehicles order every road user to the nearest edge to stop, with intersections left open [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency-yield; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F09, sec11-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A01
A funeral line follows its leader through intersections past any signal once the lead car has entered, and outsiders never break the line [A01].
Why it matters: group funeral; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F11, sec11-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A02
Carts are confined to courses and sign-posted cart roads, and only where the county or city has affirmatively allowed them [A02].
Why it matters: group cart-where; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F13, sec11-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A02
Cart drivers under 18 show a learner or driver license on public roads while drivers 18 and up show government photo identification [A02].
Why it matters: group cart-id; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A02
Carts run sunrise to sunset, cross state roads only at 45 MPH or less through controlled intersections, and take only sidewalks 5 feet or wider while yielding to walkers [A02].
Why it matters: group cart-limits; difficulty high; prereq sec11-R09; confusables sec11-F16, sec11-F17, sec11-F18, sec11-F19 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A02
Day carts carry brakes, mirror, steering, red reflectors, and safe tires, night adds headlights, brake lights, signals, and windshield, and child seats are banned from carts entirely [A02].
Why it matters: group cart-gear; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F20, sec11-F21, sec11-F22 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A02
Low-speed vehicles top out from 21 to 25 MPH on streets posted 35 MPH or less with full lights, belts, brakes, mirrors, windshield, VIN, registration, insurance, and a licensed driver [A02].
Why it matters: group lsv; difficulty high; prereq sec11-R12; confusables sec11-F23, sec11-F24 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A02
Motorcycles and mopeds share car rights and duties plus citation exposure, and no motorist may split their lane since the rider owns it fully [A02].
Why it matters: group motorcycle; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F25, sec11-F26 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0093]
